name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: 5th-century royal citadel built on a 200m granite rock monolith with world-famous frescoes, mirror wall and summit gardens.

name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic (Dalada Maligawa)
description: Sri Lanka's most venerated Buddhist shrine housing the sacred tooth relic of Lord Buddha, located beside Kandy Lake.

name: Dambulla Royal Cave Temple
description: UNESCO World Heritage site comprising 5 cavernous shrines filled with 153 Buddha statues and ancient wall murals.

name: Horton Plains National Park & World's End
description: High montane plateau at 2,100m elevation featuring a 9km loop trek to a sheer 880m drop at World's End and Baker's Falls.

name: Nuwara Eliya Hill Station & Tea Estates
description: Colonial 'Little England' hill city surrounded by lush Ceylon tea plantations, Gregory Lake and cool-climate gardens.

name: Pidurangala Rock
description: Neighboring rock outcrop offering iconic 360-degree sunrise views facing the Sigiriya Fortress.

name: Royal Botanical Gardens Peradeniya
description: Sprawling 147-acre botanical park famous for its orchid collection, giant bamboo, and palm avenues.

name: Knuckles Mountain Range
description: Rugged UNESCO cloud forest biosphere reserve ideal for multi-day trekking, waterfalls, and biodiversity.

name: Ramboda Falls
description: 109m high multi-tiered waterfall alongside the scenic Kandy-Nuwara Eliya mountain pass.

name: Riverston Peak & Pitawala Pathana
description: Wind-swept gap and grassland plateau known as the 'Mini World's End' of the Matale hills.

name: Yala National Park (Block 1)
description: Sri Lanka's flagship safari destination boasting the highest leopard density globally alongside elephants and sloth bears.

name: Galle Dutch Fort
description: UNESCO-preserved Dutch-colonial fortified town with cobblestone lanes, ocean bastions, lighthouse, and boutique shops.

name: Mirissa Beach & Whale Watching
description: Prime south-coast bay famous for early morning blue whale watching excursions and vibrant beachside nightlife.

name: Unawatuna Bay & Jungle Beach
description: Crescent golden beach with calm swimming water, reef snorkeling and nearby secluded Jungle Beach.

name: Hikkaduwa Coral Reef & Beach
description: Famous beach town renowned for sea turtle feeding on the shoreline, surfing, and glass-bottom coral reef boat rides.

name: Tangalle & Goyambokka Beach
description: Tranquil deep-south turquoise coves backed by palm groves, ideal for relaxation and turtle nesting.

name: Weligama Bay Surf Point
description: Sri Lanka's premier beginner surfboard learning bay with sandy beach break waves and iconic Taprobane Island.

name: Bundala Ramsar Wetland Park
description: UNESCO Biosphere wetland sanctuary hosting thousands of migratory flamingos, waterbirds, and crocodiles.

name: Hummanaya Natural Blowhole
description: The only natural sea blowhole in Sri Lanka, shooting ocean spray up to 30 meters into the air during high tide.

name: Matara Paravi Duwa Temple & Star Fort
description: Island Buddhist temple accessed via a cable bridge, combined with the Dutch Star Fort monument.

name: Gangaramaya Temple & Seema Malaka
description: Eclectic urban temple complex on Beira Lake housing precious artifacts, statues, and classic vintage automobiles.

name: One Galle Face & Promenade
description: Colombo's oceanfront mega-shopping mall and street-food culinary walkway on Galle Face Green.

name: National Museum of Colombo
description: Sri Lanka's largest museum exhibiting Kandyan royal regalia, ancient bronzes, and colonial heritage.

name: Colombo Lotus Tower
description: South Asia's tallest self-supported structure at 350m, offering panoramic revolving observation deck views.

name: Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara
description: Historic Buddhist temple believed to be hallowed by the Buddha's third visit to Sri Lanka, renowned for Solias Mendis frescoes.

name: Mount Lavinia Beach & Hotel
description: Colonial beach suburb famous for its historic Governor's mansion hotel, sunset seafood dining, and sandy bay.

name: Negombo Beach & Dutch Canal
description: Coastal town near CMB airport known for catamarans, Dutch canals, lagoon fish market, and beach resort strip.

name: Muthurajawela Marsh Wetland Boat Tour
description: Coastal marshland biodiversity haven ideal for boat trips observing water monitors, kingfishers, and mangroves.

name: Jaffna Fort
description: Large star-shaped fortress built by the Portuguese in 1618 and later expanded by the Dutch, overlooking Jaffna Lagoon.

name: Nallur Kandaswamy Kovil
description: Sri Lanka's premier Hindu temple complex featuring a soaring golden gopuram tower and vibrant annual chariot festivals.

name: Delft Island (Neduntheevu) & Wild Horses
description: Remote island reached by naval ferry, known for wild feral horses descended from Portuguese stock, coral walls, and baobab trees.

name: Keerimalai Naguleswaram Kovil & Mineral Springs
description: Ancient coastal natural spring pool believed to possess curative mineral properties, adjacent to a revered Shiva Kovil.

name: Casuarina Beach Karainagar
description: Pristine shallow white-sand beach lined with casuarina trees on Karainagar island in northern Jaffna.

name: Mannar Baobab Tree & Dutch Fort
description: Massive 700-year-old baobab tree planted by Arab traders, along with Mannar's historic island fort.

name: Point Pedro Northernmost Tip & Lighthouse
description: Geographical landmark marking the northernmost point of Sri Lanka with a colonial lighthouse and fishing harbor.

name: Nilaveli Beach & Pigeon Island National Park
description: White sand beach launching point for marine park boat trips to snorkel with blacktip reef sharks and sea turtles.

name: Koneswaram Temple (Swami Rock)
description: Clifftop Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, dramatically situated on Swami Rock overlooking Trincomalee's natural harbor.

name: Arugam Bay Surf Point
description: World-renowned right-point surf destination drawing international surfers, featuring laid-back beach cafes and lagoon safaris.

name: Pasikuda & Kalkudah Bay
description: Shallow reef-protected bay where visitors can walk out hundreds of meters into calm crystal-clear turquoise waters.

name: Marble Beach Trincomalee
description: Pristine secluded bay managed by the air force, named for its glass-smooth reflective water surface.

name: Kumana Bird Sanctuary & Park
description: Renowned bird sanctuary adjacent to Yala East, famous for nesting pelicans, painted storks, and wild leopard safaris.

name: Anuradhapura Sacred City & Ruwanwelisaya
description: Sri Lanka's 1st ancient royal capital featuring immense white stupas, Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi tree, and monastic ruins.

name: Polonnaruwa Ancient Kingdom & Gal Vihara
description: Medieval 12th-century capital with cyclable ruins, royal palace complex, and masterfully carved Gal Vihara rock Buddhas.

name: Minneriya National Park Elephant Gathering
description: Host to the world-famous dry-season 'Gathering' where up to 300 Asian wild elephants assemble around the Minneriya tank.

name: Mihintale Sacred Mountain Peak
description: Mountain peak sanctuary revered as the cradle of Buddhism in Sri Lanka, accessed via 1,840 carved stone steps.

name: Ritigala Strict Nature Reserve & Monastery
description: Secluded forest monastery ruins nestled on a medicinal mountain peak shrouded in myth and jungle foliage.

name: Avukana Standing Buddha Statue
description: Colossal 12-meter standing Buddha statue carved out of a solid granite rock face in the 5th century.

name: Wilpattu National Park (Main Entrance)
description: Sri Lanka's largest national park famous for natural rainwater 'Villu' lakes, leopards, sloth bears, and dense jungle.

name: Kalpitiya Peninsula & Dolphin Safaris
description: Premier kite-surfing spot and marine sanctuary famous for massive pods of hundreds of spinner dolphins.

name: Yapahuwa Rock Fortress & Kingdom
description: 13th-century rock fortress capital featuring a dramatic ornamental stone staircase guarded by lion sculptures.

name: Munneswaram Hindu Temple
description: One of Sri Lanka's five ancient Ishwarams dedicated to Lord Shiva, associated with the Ramayana epic.

name: Ridi Viharaya (Silver Temple)
description: 2nd-century BC cave temple built where silver ore was discovered to finance the construction of Ruwanwelisaya.

name: Ella Nine Arch Bridge & Little Adam's Peak
description: World-famous colonial stone railway viaduct set in lush tea valley, paired with the easy summit hike of Little Adam's Peak.

name: Ella Rock Trek
description: Challenging hill country hike through eucalyptus forests and tea estates rewarding climbers with sweeping cliffside valley views.

name: Diyaluma Falls & Upper Natural Pools
description: Sri Lanka's 2nd highest waterfall (220m) featuring natural infinity rock pools at the top edge of the cliff.

name: Ravana Falls & Ravana Cave
description: Cascading roadside waterfall associated with King Ravana of the Ramayana legend.

name: Lipton's Seat & Dambatenne Tea Factory
description: Panoramic mountain lookout point where Sir Thomas Lipton surveyed his tea empire, offering views across 7 provinces.

name: Dunhinda Falls
description: 64m high misty waterfall near Badulla town created by the Badulu Oya river.

name: Kataragama Sacred Shrine Complex
description: Multi-religious pilgrimage sanctuary venerated equally by Buddhists, Hindus, Muslims, and indigenous Vedda people.

name: Udawalawe National Park & Elephant Transit Home
description: Open reservoir grassland renowned for guaranteed wild elephant herd sightings and feeding orphaned calves at ETH.

name: Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
description: Sacred 2,243m mountain pilgrimage climb of 5,500 stone steps to a summit footprint shrine for sunrise.

name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
description: Sanctuary for orphaned wild elephants famous for daily river bathing processions down the main village street.

name: Kitulgala White Water Rafting & Adventure
description: Sri Lanka's adventure sports hub on the Kelani River, featuring Grade 3 white-water rafting, canyoning, and rain forest treks.

name: Sinharaja Rain Forest Reserve
description: UNESCO World Heritage primary virgin tropical rainforest boasting rare endemic flora, reptiles, and mixed bird feeding flocks.

name: Bopath Ella Waterfall
description: Picturesque waterfall shaped like a sacred Bo-leaf (Ficus religiosa), popular for day picnics.
